sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with AC source and a builder area where
student places diodes: options are (a) single diode (half-wave),
(b) bridge of 4 diodes (full-wave), (c) add a filter capacitor C in
parallel with the load. Oscilloscope panel shows u_out(t) live.
Sliders: input peak U_max, load R, cap C (when present). Experiment:
reach a target average U_out and target ripple amplitude by choosing
configuration + C. Evaluate: output trace hidden; only average and
ripple readouts — student must pick configuration blindly to match.
Wrinkle: diode is idealized (0 V or 0.6 V threshold toggle); "AC →
DC conversion" clicks.
